title: Stellar Horizons
description: A community-focused 18+ Whitelist Cobblemon SMP server that includes tons of different mods, plugins and features to make your experience the best that it can be!
body:
# Stellar Horizons
Stellar Horizons started off as a Cobblemon: Star Academy modpack back in January 2025 and has since evolved into it's own modpack. We are a community-driven server with tons of mods, plugins and features to ensure our players have the best experience they can.

We are a **18+ whitelist** server so there is an application process but that is to ensure we curate the kind of community that has allowed us to prosper and grow over the past year. We do not cater to anyone, there is **no P2W** and our top priority is making sure our players have fun.

## Features
- All 1025 Pokemon including custom forms made from other packs or from our own modellers
- In-Game Voice Chat **(Simple Voice Chat)**
- Mega Evolutions, Dynamax, Gigantamax, Z-Moves, Terastallization **(Mega Showdown)**
- Alpha Pokemon **(Cobblemon Alpha Project)**
- Quests **(FTB Quests + Cobblemon Quests Reloaded + ExtraQuests)**
- Instanced Loot **(Lootr)**
- Pokemon Decor **(PokeBlocks + CobbleFurnies)**
- More Biomes! **(Biomes O' Plenty)**
- More Food! **(CobbleCuisine + Farmer's Delight)**
- More Building Blocks **(_Way too many to list here, come find out!_)**

## Rules
- ✅ Microphone Required
- ✅ Be Respectful – No harassment, hate speech, or toxicity.
- ✅ No Cheating – Any exploits, hacked clients, or unfair advantages will result in a ban.
- ✅ No Spamming – Keep chat clean and on-topic.
- ✅ Follow Discord & Minecraft Guidelines – Respect Discord’s TOS and general server etiquette.
- ✅ No Griefing/Theft

## How To Join
Interested in Stellar Horizons? Follow the steps below to get started!
1. [Join the Discord!](https://discord.com/invite/stellarhorizons)
2. [Apply to the Server!](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeMUl3fiql0m0M62QwDDTbCkIkLV7E6jSeyslzzRgCj5rnChA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113358703571495500075)
   
Hope to see you soon.

Sincerely,

The Stellar Horizons Community
